scope.included: Scythe 2016 base/core multiplayer rules for 2–5 players. Full candidate revalidation against the complete supplied authoritative source, including quantities, payment and benefit order, component destinations, movement legality, all factions, every structure bonus tile, immediate ending and scoring.
scope.method: Read the full new candidate and complete 32-page extracted source; visually checked source pages 10, 13, 14, 15, 19, 20 and 29. Specifically verified the explicit Upgrade/Deploy exposed-box quantities and straight-row river qualification, then checked the entire candidate and interactions without presuming a pass.
scope.independence: No question banks, keys, reader outputs, grades, coverage, or other reports read. Source-audit-04.json was neither read nor modified. Candidate not edited.

checked_claims.topic: Game objective, flow and faction piece quantities
checked_claims.claims: Greatest final fortune; no rounds; clockwise turns and immediate sixth-star ending; five faction/player mats and six bonus tiles; per faction one character, four mechs, eight workers, four structures/recruits, six technology cubes/stars, action token and track markers; plastic units fight, workers and structures do not.

Shuffle three decks; players plus one Factory cards, remainder returned unseen; one random face-up structure tile; eleven encounter locations; supply resources/coins/multipliers; random faction/player mats and Nordic-Rusviet-Crimea-Saxony-Polania seating order.

Faction Mat power/cards versus Player Mat popularity/coins/two objectives; home-base character, two starting land-adjoined workers; correct mat locations for remaining pieces, empty one-time recruit spaces; lowest numbered mat starts; public card count/secret contents, secret objectives, coins not hidden but total need not be revealed, combat commitment may be concealed.

Different section except Rusviet, top then bottom each optional and once, either/both/neither, full exposed red cost before optional green benefits, top gains can fund bottom, dead turn when necessary, appropriate turn overlap during noninteractive bottom selection.

Bases never territories; normal home-base move/build/deploy prohibition with setup/retreat/Wayfare exceptions; two expansion placeholders; unit or unoccupied own structure control, enemy worker controls own structure's territory/resources; enemy gains no building ability, owner keeps ability except uncontrolled Mill, defender temporarily controls pending combat.

Wood/food/metal/oil only; workers not resources; resource tokens remain on board, any controlled territory can fund remote actions, payment to supply; unlimited resources and friendly stacking; all units carry any resources, only mechs carry workers, never characters; carried workers retain independent movement eligibility.

Move two different units one adjacent step sequentially or gain one coin before upgrades; no default river/lake movement; lake reaches adjoining shores; printed tunnels adjacent and personal Mine usable even under enemy control; enemy structure alone does not block entry; worker hostile-entry restrictions; enemy workers or plastic units stop character/mech movement, encounter stops character for turn; Speed adds a character/mech step and permits intermediate loading.

Unprotected workers retreat immediately to own home leaving resources with one popularity lost each, down to zero and no combat; finish other unit moves then all attacker-ordered combats before encounter and subsequent bottom action; contested encounter lost leaves token.

One coin for two power or one combat card before upgrades, combat reshuffle/no-card exhaustion procedure; one coin for two resources any combination or one popularity, resource destination controlled worker territory, no resource Trade if all workers at home; Monument popularity and Armory power bonuses.

Full current exposed cost before production; two distinct controlled territories before upgrades; each worker may produce one terrain token on same territory; metal/mountain, oil/tundra, food/farm, wood/forest, worker/village, none/lake and Factory; new workers left to right after payment, optional and permanent, exposed costs only affect future actions; controlled Mill adds bonus territory and its own worker-equivalent output alongside actual workers, including without workers.

Upgrade oil, Deploy metal, Build wood, Enlist food; mat costs/coins, optional coins, announcement, continued paid action after completion gives coins/recruits; cube from green to empty bracketed red, no solid-border upgrade; normal mech/building placement controlled worker territory, no lake/home base, ability unlocked for all plastic units not workers.

One structure total per territory including opponents, Factory allowed, structures immovable/indestructible; future top-action Armory/Monument benefits, controlled Mill, Mine personal tunnel with any unit movement including Factory; opponent cannot use structure abilities.

Any recruit to any empty permanent one-time bonus, two power/coins/popularity/cards; ongoing bonus follows original section, one power/Upgrade, coin/Deploy, popularity/Build, card/Enlist; own and immediate neighbors' matching bottom action, active-left-right sequence; once for opponent in two-player; excludes top, Factory and encounters; sixth star halts later bonuses.

Rusviet repeats including Factory, Crimea one card once per turn as one resource irrespective of value, Nordic workers cross rivers not lakes, Polania two different options from one encounter in either order and first benefit can fund second, Saxony uncapped available combat/objective stars and retains other objective.

checked_claims.topic: Riverwalk and Speed across all factions
checked_claims.claims: Rusviet farms/villages, Crimea farms/tundra, Nordic and Saxony forests/mountains, Polania villages/mountains; all unlocked plastic-unit abilities, all factions can unlock Speed, workers excluded.
Underpass connects controlled mountains and tunnels including own Mine for character/mechs; Disarm two opponent track power before tunnel/Mine combat once per combat.
Township controlled villages and Factory adjacency; People's Army one extra combat card total if worker present, still requires plastic unit; two mechs plus three workers permit three cards.
Seaworthy lake movement and optional adjacent-lake retreat including carried workers; Artillery one power paid to remove two opponent power before combat, once per combat.
Wayfare to own or inactive home bases including unused expansion bases irrespective of distance, not active opponent bases; Scout one random opposing card before combat once per combat.

Submerge lake entry/exit and any lake to another; Camaraderie protects combat-aggressor worker retreat only, not undefended workers; no abandoned workers/resources on lakes, workers need mech to leave; no lake building/deploy, possible lake battles; Polania lacks Nordic lake retreat exception.

Attacks allowed at zero power/popularity, attacker ability first; simultaneous secret dial 0 through lesser of seven/current power, one card per plastic unit plus Rusviet exception, zero dial may use cards; reveal sum, attacker ties, both deduct dial power and discard used cards face-up without card-value track loss; winner controls resources and places eligible star; ordinary two combat stars versus Saxony; loser all units retreat leaving resources, Nordic exception, attacker-only worker popularity penalty including lake workers, positive revealed power earns loser one card.

Character only and stops for turn; after all Move/combats before subsequent bottom, token stays if lost battle; card shown and thematic capitals read aloud; required one affordable option except Polania up-to-two rule, optional benefit but full cost; resources/units/buildings all at encounter location; no normal action costs/mat/recruit bonuses; card face-down under encounter deck.

Each character's first completed Move there must choose one permanent card, no exchange; fifth section with optional top then bottom and normal repeat rule/Rusviet exception; no analogous mat coins/building/recruit bonuses; bottom moves one unit two steps or three with Speed for plastic units, all ordinary stops and Mine access apply.

Own-turn reveal only before/after top/bottom with all requirements met at reveal; may defer; normal objective star and both cards bottom-deck, Saxony retains second; informal agreements unenforceable, only coins tangible exchange and not for tournament deals; initiated combat cannot be cancelled by negotiation.

Six upgrades, four mechs/buildings/recruits, eight workers, objective, combat up to two, eighteen popularity and sixteen power; permanent stars, no blocking others; sixth star immediate with no further turn; bottom primary/coins/own recruit benefit collected before ending star, active-left-right neighbor resolution, later bonuses blocked; undo unresolved attack movement.

Held coins plus stars/territories/resource pairs and selected structure bonus; 0–6 pays 3/2/1, 7–12 pays 4/3/2, 13–18 pays 5/4/3; pair controlled resources across territories and ignore odd token, no workers/cards; lakes count, home bases not, Factory three total; example totals 53; tie order workers+mechs+structures, power, popularity, resources, territories, stars.

Adjacent printed tunnels 1/2–3/4–5/6 pay 2/4/6/9; adjacent lakes and encounters 1/2–3/4–5/6–7 pay 2/4/6/9; printed tunnels with structures 1/2/3–4 pay 2/4/6; longest straight structure row and combined farm/tundra structures 1/2/3/4 pay 2/4/6/9; each adjacent feature only once, Mine not tunnel feature, removed encounter tokens still count, rivers do not break adjacency/row, structures score even under enemy control, zero gives zero.

conclusion: PASS for the exact candidate-repair-03.md hash recorded above. The explicit Upgrade/Deploy quantities and river qualification are source-supported. Full revalidation found no material error or important core multiplayer rules omission.
